title: Desert, forest, ice: the world in 1900 and now
excerpt: In 1900 farms covered 19% of the world's ice-free land. Today they cover 37%. Two maps from HYDE 3.3 show where the new fields and pastures came from, which forests went, and where the trees came back.
seo_description: The world's land in 1900 and now: farmland grew from 19% to 37% of ice-free land. Swipe map of cropland, grazing, forest and wildlands.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Desert, forest, ice' in gold, green and pale blue on cream, beside two world maps of farmland in 1900 and 2023 shaded from cream to dark brown. Text: farms covered 19% of the world's ice-free land in 1900; today 37%.
